description: This file defines a DeviceDetectionService class for detecting device characteristics (e.g., tablet, phone, iOS, Android, iPhone X) in a React Native application. It includes methods for setting device size, orientation, and platform-specific checks.

classes.name: DeviceDetectionService
classes.description: A service class for detecting device type, size, orientation, and platform specifics in a React Native environment.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the service and sets default device values.

methods.name: isTablet
methods.description: Returns whether the device is a tablet using react-native-device-info.

methods.name: setNewValues
methods.description: Updates device size and platform-related properties.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets device size and orientation, updating related properties.

methods.name: getDeviceSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the device size relative to a base unit.

methods.name: getScreenSize
methods.description: Returns the screen width relative to a base unit.

methods.name: checkSmallTab
methods.description: Determines if the device is a small tablet or phone based on size and orientation.

methods.name: isPhoneOrTablet
methods.description: Sets flags indicating whether the device is a phone or tablet.

methods.name: isIosOrAndroid
methods.description: Sets flags for iOS or Android platform.

methods.name: detectIphoneX
methods.description: Detects if the device is an iPhone X based on dimensions.

methods.name: isLargeTablet
methods.description: Returns true if the device is a large tablet.
